four_text_editions_phase_1_alpha.scope: Digital editions for Oration, Commento, Heptaplus, On Being and Unity with angelology focus
expected_deliverables: ~97 angelology-focused conclusion entries across four texts
Cross-reference web linking all four texts to shared angelology themes
Bonus: Heretical conclusions Q1, Q6, Q8 deeply contextualized via angelology

oration.english_title: Oration on the Dignity of Man
oration.research_context: Borghesi critical edition with extensive commentary. Copenhaver's Magic and Dignity analysis. Howlett's concordism framework.
key_angelology_sections: Opening: Why are humans compared to angels? (Pseudo-Dionysius hierarchy)
Middle: The ladder of ascent (sensate -> rational -> angelic -> divine)
Middle: What is an angel? What is a human? (Contrast: fixity vs. freedom)
Closing: Philosophy as ascent to angelhood (the Platonic goal)
oration.synergy_with_heretical: Understanding Oration's angelology is prerequisite for Q1 (incarnation via angelic intermediaries)

commento.english_title: Commentary on a Love Canzone by Girolamo Benivieni
commento.primary_source_markdown: Allen_MichaelJ_B_Studies_in_the_Platonism_of_Marsilio_Ficino_and_Giovanni_Pico_Routledge_pdf_8084ac74.md (partial); full Commento may need sourcing from critical edition
commento.research_context: Allen's critical translation. Busi's Kabbalah analysis. Edelheit on scholastic psychology. Wirszubski on Sefirot.
key_angelology_sections: Book I: Angels as exemplars of love (Plotinian eros)
Book I: Sefirotic correspondences (seraphim = Chokmah/Wisdom)
Book I-II: The ladder of love (human -> angelic -> divine)
Book II: Angelic intellection as model for human rational soul (participatory)
Book III: Seraphim as final union with divine love (contemplative goal)
commento.synergy_with_heretical: Commento's angelology (especially seraphim as divine love) illuminates Q6 (eucharist as perpetual incarnation)

heptaplus.full_title: Heptaplus: On the Sevenfold Narration of the Six Days of Creation
heptaplus.research_context: Borghesi + Papio English translation. Black's definitive The Heptaplus study. Howlett on cosmology. Edelheit on angelology. Akopyan on astrology.
key_angelology_sections: Day 1, Layer 1 (Literal): 'Light' as the angelic intellect created first
Day 1, Layer 2 (Allegorical): Angelic hierarchies as the cosmic Nous (Pseudo-Dionysius)
Day 2: Angelic separation of intelligible from material (the Veil)
Day 4: Sun/Moon/Stars as angelic ministers; planetary rulership
Day 5: Demonic opposition to angelic protection (the cosmic warfare)
Day 6: Human as battleground between angelic intellect and animal sense
Day 1, Layer 5 (Kabbalistic): Sefiroth with their angelic names and invocations
Day 1, Layer 6 (Astrological): Planetary angels as cosmic governors; magical correspondences
heptaplus.synergy_with_heretical: Heptaplus angelology is THE key to understanding heretical conclusions about cosmological intermediaries and demonic obstruction (Q8)

being_unity.primary_source_markdown: Heptaplus_Pico_della_Mirandola_On_the_Dignity_of_Man_Being_and_One_pdf_29945776.md (same file as Heptaplus) OR separate Borghesi edition
being_unity.research_context: Borghesi critical text. Howlett on neoplatonism (Plotinus vs. Aristotle reconciliation). Edelheit on metaphysics. Allen on Ficino critique.
key_angelology_sections: Book II: Angelic orders as hierarchical degrees of being (Pseudo-Dionysius via Plotinus)
Book II: Seraph as exemplar of pure unity approaching divinity
Book III: Human intellection as participatory in angelic intellect
Book IV: How angels relate to matter-form composition (Aquinas synthesis)
Demonic as privation (absence of being/goodness)
being_unity.synergy_with_heretical: On Being and Unity's angelology solves Q1 (can God be embodied? Yes, through angelic intermediation)

H2-A_ORATION.task_description: Extract angelology passages from Oration on the Dignity of Man

instructions.extract_strategy: Read Oration sequentially. Extract ALL passages mentioning angels, hierarchy, divine intellect, ascent, seraphim. For each passage: (1) exact Latin/English quote, (2) context (what is Pico arguing?), (3) lineage tag (Pseudo-Dionysius/Aquinas/Kabbalah/Plotinus), (4) cross-references to other Pico works.
key_passages_to_find: Opening: dignity through free will (contrast to angels)
Comparison: angels as pure intellect vs. humans as flexible
Hierarchy: the ladder from beasts through humans to angels
Closing: philosophy as ascent to angelhood

H3-A_COMMENTO.task_description: Extract angelology passages from Commento sopra una canzone d'amore

instructions.extract_strategy: Commento is organized in Books I-III. Focus on: (1) Book I on angelic exemplars, (2) Sefirotic correspondences (seraphim=Chokmah), (3) Ascent through angelic knowledge, (4) Seraphim as final goal. Mark Kabbalistic passages explicitly.
key_passages_to_find: Book I: Angels as exemplars (what we aspire to become)
Book I: Seraphim as pure love/fire
Book II: Human love ascending toward angelic love
Book III: Contemplative union with seraphim as perfection

H4-A_HEPTAPLUS.task_description: Extract angelology passages from Heptaplus (all seven layers, all six days)

instructions.extract_strategy: Heptaplus is densely layered. For EACH day (1-6), extract angelology content from EACH layer (1-7), generating tagged passages. Day 1 is most angel-rich (creation of intellect/light). Layers 2, 5, 6 are angelology-heavy across all days.

layer_focus.Layer_1_Literal: Angels as light/intellect created on Day 1
layer_focus.Layer_2_Allegorical: Angels as cosmic intellect (Nous); Pseudo-Dionysius hierarchy
layer_focus.Layer_5_Kabbalistic: Sefiroth with angelic names; invocatory magic
layer_focus.Layer_6_Astrological: Planetary angels as cosmic governors; stellar correspondences
layer_focus.Layers_3_4_7: Note angelology-adjacent content (moral, anagogical, numerological implications)

key_passages_to_find_per_day.Day_1: Light as first creation (angels); hierarchies; Sefirotic emanation
key_passages_to_find_per_day.Day_4: Sun/Moon/Stars as angelic ministers; planetary magic
key_passages_to_find_per_day.Day_6: Human as soul (angelic intellect in animal body)

H5-A_BEING_UNITY.task_description: Extract angelology passages from De Ente et Uno (On Being and Unity)

instructions.extract_strategy: On Being and Unity is metaphysically dense. Extract passages on: (1) angelic orders as degrees of being, (2) seraph as exemplar of unity, (3) human participation in angelic intellect, (4) demonic as privation. Connect to Aquinas, Plotinus, Pseudo-Dionysius as sources.
key_passages_to_find: Book II: Angelic hierarchy as emanative levels of being
Book II: Seraph as simplicity/unity approaching God
Book III: Human soul receiving angelic intellection
Book IV: Angels and the matter-form principle

S1-A.task_description: Write angelology exegeses across all four texts (cross-text synthesis)
S1-A.input: All ported entries from P1-A, P2-A, P3-A, P4-A
S1-A.instructions: For each angelology entry across all four texts, write exegesis explaining: (1) what Pico says, (2) philosophical function (why this matters architecturally), (3) lineage (Pseudo-Dionysius/Aquinas/Kabbalah/Plotinus/synthesis), (4) cross-text resonance (where else does this idea appear?), (5) scholarly debate (what do Howlett, Edelheit, Wirszubski, Black argue?). Reference ANGELICRESEARCH.md throughout.

S2-A.task_description: Create shared angelology scholarship database (lineage tagging + scholar debate log)
S2-A.input: All exegeses from S1-A + scholarship corpus
S2-A.instructions: Organize all angelology citations by lineage (Pseudo-Dionysius, Aquinas, Kabbalah, Plotinus). Log scholarly disagreements (e.g., Wirszubski vs. Allen on how deeply Pico understood Kabbalah). Create cross-reference web linking all four texts.

R1-A.task_description: Validate angelology entries against ANGELICRESEARCH.md + STYLE_GUIDE.md
R1-A.input: All entries + exegeses from P1-A–P4-A and S1-A–S2-A
checklist: [ ] Angelology passage accurately quoted from source?
[ ] Cross-references point to correct locations in all four texts?
[ ] Scholarly citations backed by corpus (Howlett, Edelheit, Wirszubski, Black, Allen, Busi, Akopyan)?
[ ] Exegesis explains philosophical function, not just content?

phases: Phase 1-Alpha harvesting (H2-A through H5-A run in parallel)
Phase 1-Alpha porting (P1-A through P4-A run in parallel, after harvesting complete)
Phase 1-Alpha synthesis (S1-A + S2-A run in parallel, after porting complete)
Phase 1-Alpha review (R1-A runs after synthesis complete)
